fields.value: A highly motivated, results-oriented sustainability leader with over 14 years of total work experience, including a 9 -year track record of driving sustainable business transformation and creating long-term value. Having proven expertise in developing and executing comprehensive ESG strategies, implementing sustainable business practices, and fostering stakeholder engagement to mitigate risk and enhance brand image. Adept at managing high-performing, cross-functional teams and engaging with C-suite executives, investors and regulatory bodies. Experience includes overseeing the implementation of ESG reporting frameworks such as GRI, BRSR, TCFD and SASB; GHG inventory development; climate risk management; decarbonization; value chain sustainability; responsible financing, implementing business management systems; facilitating audits and building constructive relationships. Passionate about translating complex environmental data into clear and actionable insights. Transparent disclosures through Integrated Annual Reporting, stakeholder interactions and responses against rating requirements have led to top-tier ESG ratings. Consultation provided for various industry sectors namely BFSI, Oil and Gas, Renewable Energy, FMCG, IT, Electronic and Heavy Machinery manufacturers and Shipping. Professional qualification includes M. Tech, certificate course on tropical coastal ecosystems and certified lead auditor for EMS.

fields.value: Key deliverables include the Integrated Annual Report, BRSR and GHG Inventory along with water and waste, Climate Risk assessment along with stakeholder engagement and assurance coordination.
